pathophysiology.summary: Nocturnal polyuria can be caused by medical conditions (diabetes mellitus, diabetes insipidus, adrenal insufficiency, hypercalcaemia, liver failure, polyuric renal failure, chronic heart failure, obstructive sleep apnoea) and by drugs (calcium channel blockers, diuretics, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors). Oral desmopressin is considered only after medical causes are excluded and other treatments have failed. Serum sodium is checked 3 days after the first desmopressin dose and treatment stopped if sodium falls below the normal range.
